tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background and the base ground of every screen. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, ink-subtle.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, popovers, input fields, message bubbles. Sits on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken or recessed areas: code blocks, sidebars, table headers, hovered rows. Sits on surface-100.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules. Never the only cue that a control exists (use border-control).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls (inputs, outlined buttons, checkboxes). 3:1 or better on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, helper text, metadata on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and placeholders on surface-100 and surface-200 only. Lowest legible text; do not use on surface-300.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill for primary buttons: the one main action per view. Warm near-black in light, cream in dark. Text on it: on-primary (14:1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary buttons. Text on it: on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for primary buttons. Text on it: on-primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, primary-hover and primary-pressed.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one warm brand color, used small: send button, checked toggles and checkboxes, selected-tab underline, one key icon per area. Text on it: on-accent. Not for primary buttons (they use primary) or body text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for accent controls such as the send button. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for accent controls. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text and links on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300 and accent-tint.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Soft accent background: selected rows, highlighted callouts, user message bubble. Text on it: ink or accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-muted
tokens.usage: Decorative accent fill for shapes and illustrations (the cover, avatar grounds). Never a text ground.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Background for neutral badges, chips and nav-item hover. Text on it: ink or ink-muted (5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals and dialogs. Never put text directly on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on accent, accent-hover and accent-pressed. White in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus outline on every interactive element. 3:1 or better on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300 in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface and success-tint. A blue-leaning teal, not green. Always paired with a check icon or the word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background for success badges and callouts. Text on it: success.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text and icons on surface and danger-tint. Always paired with an icon or the word, never color alone.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background for error badges and callouts. Text on it: danger.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surface and warning-tint. Always paired with an icon or the word.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background for warning badges and callouts. Text on it: warning.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons on surface and info-tint.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background for info badges and callouts. Text on it: info.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero and empty-state headline. One per screen, serif.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles and section openers, serif.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Top-level heading inside a page or document, serif.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Sub-section heading and card title, serif.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy and form labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, menu items and form labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, timestamps, metadata. Use ink-muted.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small uppercase category labels in ink-muted. The token cannot set casing: add the .overline class from bundle.css, or text-transform: uppercase. Use sparingly.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code on surface-300.

spacing.note: 4px base. Every gap, padding and margin is one of these steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tight badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, gap inside a list item.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default component padding and gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page-level vertical rhythm on marketing pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small chips, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, callouts, message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels, composer, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, avatars, filter chips.

shadow.note: Soft, warm, low. Prefer borders; use shadow only to lift floating layers.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards that need a hint of lift.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers and the message composer.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and dialogs.
